releaseNotes.headline: Claude, Cursor, and Grok Build, built in
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.7 reads the Claude Code, Cursor, and Grok Build sign-ins already on your Mac and shows their live limits beside Codex.

highlights.title: Claude Code limits
highlights.detail: Your 5-hour session and weekly windows on one ring, with Opus, Sonnet, and extra-usage buckets available in Settings.

highlights.title: Cursor and Grok Build limits
highlights.detail: Cursor’s plan usage per model pool and Grok Build’s included credits, each with its reset date.

highlights.title: Connection status
highlights.detail: Manage AI Tools shows each supported tool’s sign-in state and what to do when one is expired or missing.
